text:
lina: Heads-up: sketch for an evacuation coordinator to reduce head-of-line blocking during tenant drains. TL;DR: short-lived per-lane evac tokens + prioritized soft-evict path. Pasting rough outline.
raj: Who owns the decision to create an evac token — scheduler or adapter?
elina: scheduler (runs global admission). adapter only sends backpressure hints. evac token issued when queueing latency or depth crosses threshold OR when preemption requested. token stops new window-joins and adjusts batching heuristics for draining.
emily: How do we avoid regressing KV cache warmup? aggressive drains could trash caches and spike cost.
lina: Good call. token carries a warm_preserve flag + TTL. If warm_preserve=true we switch to a slow-drain that prefers keeping active KV affinity for top N sessions; otherwise we do aggressive coalesce.
sanjay: Metric checklist we should expose: evac_token_rate, avg_drain_latency, kv_hit_ratio_delta, forced_evict_count. Also feature-flaggable rollout per fleet.
raj: Edge case: long-lived streaming requests — can't evict mid-stream. fallback idea: when token sees streaming sessions, route them to soft-fallback model-variant or isolate them to a different lane to avoid slowing the drain.
emily: Can you paste a quick config sketch?
lina: ```
evac_coord:
  threshold_queue_ms: 2000
  token_ttl_ms: 15000
  warm_preserve_pct: 0.25
  soft_evict_mode: coalesce
  priority_formula: tenant_risk_score + age * 0.1
```
deploy-bot: :information_source: rollout started for feature/evac-coordinator on cluster-dev (canary 5%) at 2024-11-05T14:20:00Z
sanjay: We must guard against cross-lane starvation. proposal: tokens carry priority and we allow a bounded number of concurrent evac tokens per GPU; older tokens get priority bump so a tenant in-progress eventually finishes.
raj: Agreed. Also need a graceful fallback when token_ttl expires but drain incomplete — requeue with exponential backoff and emit eviction_event.
emily: I'll run a small canary on dev GPUs and collect: p50/p95/p99 latency, kv-hit ratio, throughput. I can instrument probe requests to simulate warm sessions.
lina: :thumbsup: thanks. I'll draft the RFC follow-up with sequence diagrams (token lifecycle, adapter signals, fallback path) and list the observability panels. Add this to tomorrow's runtime sync agenda.
raj: volunteers for implementation pairing? i'm available next Wed afternoon.
sanjay: I can help with rollout automation and the metrics dashboard.
emily: I'll own the canary runs and dashboards.
lina: Excellent — will circulate the draft by EOD.
